methods.name: STRT-seq

methods.title: STRT-seq-2i: dual-index 5' single cell and nucleus RNA-seq on an addressable microwell array
methods.summary: STRT-seq on an addressable 9600-microwell array, with dual-index barcodes and cell sampling by limiting dilution or FACS.

methods.name: Sturgeon V2
methods.title: Sturgeon V2: a clinically applicable CNS tumor classifier trained on relabeled data
methods.summary: Locally executable CNS tumour classifier for sparse nanopore methylation profiles, retrained on relabeled public reference data with a redesigned architecture.

methods.name: Subtypist
methods.title: Data-driven identification of cell subtypes for single-cell transcriptomic data with Subtypist
methods.summary: Data-driven multiscale iterative algorithm that identifies new cell subtypes in scRNA-seq without reference labels.

methods.name: SURGE
methods.title: SURGE: uncovering context-specific genetic-regulation of gene expression from single-cell RNA sequencing using latent-factor models
methods.summary: Unsupervised latent-factor discovery of context-specific eQTLs from single-cell transcriptomic data.

methods.name: Swap-seq
methods.title: Systematic mapping of enhancers, silencers, and topological elements with prime editing deletion screens
methods.summary: Pooled twin prime-editing deletion screen with flow sorting that measures how endogenous regulatory elements change expression of a nearby gene.

methods.name: T-Scan
methods.title: T-Scan: A Genome-wide Method for the Systematic Discovery of T Cell Epitopes
methods.summary: Lentiviral antigen libraries are expressed in target cells, T-cell-recognised cells are sorted with a granzyme B reporter, and the antigens are identified by sequencing.

methods.name: T2G
methods.title: T2G: fast and accurate transcriptome to genome BAM liftover for short and long read RNA sequencing
methods.summary: Converts complete BAM files from transcriptome to genome coordinates while keeping CIGAR strings, tags and RNA modification calls.

methods.name: TACTIC
methods.title: TACTIC: hybrid denoising and clustering for robust 16S amplicon diversity estimates
methods.summary: 16S rRNA amplicon analysis tool offering hybrid post-denoising clustering strategies (Taxonomy-Informed and Taxonomy-Agnostic Clustering) to reduce within-species splitting of zOTUs.

methods.name: TAP-seq
methods.title: Targeted Perturb-seq enables genome-scale genetic screens in single cells
methods.summary: Single-cell RNA-seq coverage focused on genes of interest, so CRISPR perturbation effects are detected with far fewer sequencing reads.

methods.name: TAPS
methods.title: Bisulfite-free direct detection of 5-methylcytosine and 5-hydroxymethylcytosine at base resolution
methods.summary: Bisulfite-free base-resolution detection of 5mC and 5hmC; TET oxidation plus pyridine borane reduction converts modified cytosines so they read as T, leaving unmodified C and DNA integrity intact.

methods.name: TARGET-seq
methods.title: Unravelling Intratumoral Heterogeneity through High-Sensitivity Single-Cell Mutational Analysis and Parallel RNA Sequencing
methods.summary: Single-cell targeted mutation detection from genomic and coding DNA, paired with whole-transcriptome RNA-seq from the same cell.

methods.name: tATAC-see
methods.title: Targeted ATAC-see - a visual assay for target-specific chromatin profiling
methods.summary: Antibody-tethered Tn5 tagmentation combined with ATAC-see imaging, with salt-tuned tagmentation radius, to profile chromatin around a chosen protein-occupied domain.

methods.name: Taxonova
methods.title: Taxonova: Deep learning enables fast and confidence-aware microbiome species-level amplicon classification

methods.name: TEA-seq
methods.title: Simultaneous trimodal single-cell measurement of transcripts, epitopes, and chromatin accessibility using TEA-seq
methods.summary: Droplet-based trimodal assay that measures RNA, surface epitopes and chromatin accessibility from the same single cells.

methods.name: TERRA
methods.title: Multi-scale modeling of human tissues from spatial transcriptomics with TERRA
methods.summary: Spatial transcriptomics foundation model pretrained on over 100 million human cells to learn transferable tissue-organisation representations.

methods.name: TF-CUT&Tag
methods.title: Engineered Tn5 Variants Enhance CUT&Tag Fidelity for Transcription Factors
methods.summary: CUT&Tag variant using engineered Tn5 (K160A or K249A) with attenuated DNA-binding, improving recovery of transcription-factor binding sites.

methods.name: TFActProfiler
methods.title: A transcription factor regulatory atlas for activity inference and perturbation prediction
methods.summary: TF-mRNA resource and framework that learns signed regulatory coefficients from ChIP, motif and curated priors plus RNA-seq atlases for TF activity and perturbation prediction.

methods.name: Tiled-C
methods.title: Dynamics of the 4D genome during in vivo lineage specification and differentiation
methods.summary: Low-input chromosome conformation capture (3C) technique for chromatin architecture at high resolution during in vivo differentiation.

methods.name: Tiled-MCC
methods.title: Analysis of sub-kilobase chromatin topology reveals nano-scale regulatory interactions with variable dependence on cohesin and CTCF
methods.summary: Micro-Capture-C with oligos tiled across a whole region, giving all-vs-all contacts within the captured locus.

methods.name: TIME-seq
methods.title: TIME-seq reduces time and cost of DNA methylation measurement for epigenetic clock construction
methods.summary: Highly multiplexed tagmentation-based targeted methylation sequencing used to build low-cost epigenetic clocks.

methods.name: TimeLapse-seq
methods.title: TimeLapse-seq: adding a temporal dimension to RNA sequencing through nucleoside recoding
methods.summary: Bulk RNA-seq that chemically recodes 4-thiouridine into cytidine analogs so newly transcribed RNA is marked by U-to-C mutations.

methods.name: TimeVault
methods.title: A genetically encoded device for transcriptome storage in mammalian cells
methods.summary: Genetically encoded vault particles capture polyadenylated mRNA inside living cells to store a transcriptome snapshot for later readout.

methods.name: TIP-seq
methods.title: High-throughput single-cell epigenomic profiling by targeted insertion of promoters (TIP-seq)
methods.summary: Antibody-tethered Tn5 inserts a T7 promoter at target sites; in vitro transcription amplifies them linearly for single-cell chromatin profiling.

methods.name: TOPmentation
methods.title: MLL-AF4 cooperates with PAF1 and FACT to drive high-density enhancer interactions in leukemia
methods.summary: Optimised high-throughput ChIPmentation for weakly bound non-histone proteins from ~100,000 cells. Named only in the Results section.

methods.name: Torino
methods.title: Reference-free isoform discovery links unannotated RNA processing to disease risk
methods.summary: Non-negative matrix factorization of read coverage across samples to find annotation-free RNA processing patterns such as intron retention.

methods.name: Trac-looping
methods.title: Trac-looping measures genome structure and chromatin accessibility
methods.summary: Transposase inserts a bivalent linker between interacting regions, capturing chromatin contacts and accessibility without fragmentation or ligation.

methods.name: TRACE-seq
methods.title: Transposase-assisted tagmentation of RNA/DNA hybrid duplexes
methods.summary: Tn5 directly tagments RNA/DNA hybrids, giving rapid one-tube low-input RNA-seq library construction.

methods.name: TransBind2
methods.title: TransBind2: Improving Transcription Factor-DNA Binding Prediction with Multimodal Data and Bidirectional Cross Attention
methods.summary: Protein-aware, multimodal transcription-factor binding predictor with bidirectional cross-attention over DNA and TF features.

methods.name: Tri-C
methods.title: Single-allele chromatin interactions identify regulatory hubs in dynamic compartmentalized domains
methods.summary: 3C approach that captures concurrent chromatin interactions among multiple elements on individual alleles and within single cells.

methods.name: TriLock-FISH
methods.title: TriLock-FISH enables in situ discrimination of influenza cRNA and mRNA for single-cell analysis of viral replication and transcription
methods.summary: Triple-lock FISH probes that discriminate influenza vRNA, cRNA and mRNA in situ, giving a spatial, subcellular atlas of RNA abundance and localisation.

methods.name: TS-SNAD
methods.title: Long-read sequencing reveals widespread novel splicing and neojunction-derived neoantigens in nasopharyngeal carcinoma

methods.name: TSvelo
methods.title: Comprehensive RNA velocity by modeling the cascade of gene regulation, transcription, and splicing from single-cell RNA sequencing data with TSvelo
methods.summary: RNA velocity framework using neural ODEs to model transcription and splicing cascades with a shared latent time.

methods.name: tTEscanR
methods.title: tTEscanR: A user-friendly integrative R package for quantifying and visualizing translation efficiency from sequencing data in diverse biological systems
methods.summary: R package estimating translation efficiency from codon demand and tRNA anticodon availability using transcript and accessibility count matrices.

methods.name: TwinC
methods.title: Prediction and functional interpretation of inter-chromosomal genome architecture from DNA sequence with TwinC
methods.summary: Interpretable convolutional neural network that predicts trans (inter-chromosomal) contacts from DNA sequence.

methods.name: txci-ATAC-seq
methods.title: txci-ATAC-seq: a massive-scale single-cell technique to profile chromatin accessibility
methods.summary: Tn5 pre-indexing of nuclei across samples followed by 10x barcoding, scaling scATAC to about 200,000 nuclei per reaction.

methods.name: UcTCRp
methods.title: UcTCRp: a TCRβ-based framework for identifying and profiling MAIT- and iNKT-associated repertoire signals
methods.summary: TCRβ-only framework that detects and profiles MAIT- and iNKT-associated signals in bulk and single-cell immune repertoires.

methods.name: UniCure
methods.title: UniCure: A multi-modal model for predicting personalized cancer therapy response
methods.summary: Multi-modal foundation-model framework predicting drug-induced transcriptomic responses for individualised drug ranking.

methods.name: UniLoopNet
methods.title: An extensible deep learning framework for multi-type chromatin interaction prediction through hierarchical adaptation strategies
methods.summary: Multi-task deep-learning framework that predicts chromatin interactions (enhancer-promoter, enhancer-enhancer, CTCF loops, stripes) from DNA sequence.

methods.name: UPM
methods.title: How Much Can AI Virtual Cells Gain from Unified Perturbational Modeling?
methods.summary: VAE-based virtual-cell predictor that integrates heterogeneous Perturb-seq datasets through gene-channel alignment, shared perturbation encoding and joint embedding.

methods.name: VASA-seq

methods.title: High-throughput total RNA sequencing in single cells using VASA-seq
methods.summary: Total-RNA single-cell sequencing that fragments and tails all RNA after lysis, so non-polyadenylated and non-coding transcripts are captured.

methods.name: vep-rs

methods.summary: Rust reimplementation of Ensembl VEP release 115.2 for high-throughput variant consequence annotation, audited term by term against VEP.

methods.name: VHAMSTeR

methods.summary: Immunoprecipitates antibodies from serum against a phage library displaying all human viral peptides and reads the bound clones by DNA sequencing.

methods.name: Virtual microfluidics
methods.title: Virtual microfluidics for digital quantification and single-cell sequencing

methods.name: ViScore

methods.name: ViVAE

methods.summary: Deep-learning embedding model for scRNA-seq data that improves multi-scale structure preservation relative to existing dimensionality-reduction methods.

methods.name: WAGES

methods.summary: Explainable topological data analysis framework that uses perturbation to identify the molecular determinants of persistent-homology structure in single-cell data.
